message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering public vulnerability information newly reported or materially updated in the last 24 hours for the scheduled July 18, 2026 IST run. Confirmed relevant findings were found for Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Zoom, NGINX, and Tenable/Nessus Agent.

**Finding 1: Google Chrome Stable Channel security update**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: Chrome Stable desktop security update; includes CVE-2026-15899, CVE-2026-15900, CVE-2026-15901, CVE-2026-15902, CVE-2026-15903, CVE-2026-15904, and CVE-2026-15905
- Severity: Critical for CVE-2026-15899, CVE-2026-15900, and CVE-2026-15901; High for CVE-2026-15902 through CVE-2026-15905, per Google
- Description: Google released a Chrome Stable desktop update on July 16 with seven listed security fixes, including use-after-free, out-of-bounds read/write, and V8-related issues.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Google Chrome, and the Google release explicitly applies to Chrome Stable for desktop platforms.
- Source: Google Chrome Releases: https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/07/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_049796704.html

**Finding 2: Microsoft Edge Stable security update**

- Product: Microsoft Edge
- Issue: Microsoft Edge Stable 150.0.4078.83 / Chromium security updates
- Severity: Mixed; Microsoft states the update incorporates the latest Chromium security updates, while the corresponding Chromium release includes Critical and High severity fixes.
- Description: Microsoft released Edge Stable 150.0.4078.83 on July 17, incorporating current Chromium security updates.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Microsoft Edge, and Microsoft’s release notes identify the Stable Channel security update.
- Source: Microsoft Edge security release notes: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnotes-security ; Microsoft Edge Stable release notes: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-stable-channel

**Finding 3: Zoom Workplace for Windows improper input validation**

- Product: Zoom
- Issue: ZSB-26014 / CVE-2026-53412
- Severity: Critical, per Zoom
- Description: Zoom lists an improper input validation vulnerability in Zoom Workplace for Windows, published July 14 and updated July 15. Public reporting in the last 24 hours says the issue could allow unauthenticated account takeover over the network.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Zoom, and Zoom Workplace is the current Zoom desktop client family.
- Source: Zoom Security Bulletins: https://www.zoom.com/en/trust/security-bulletin/ ; The Hacker News coverage: https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/zoom-patches-critical-windows-flaw-that.html

**Finding 4: NGINX memory-safety vulnerabilities**

- Product: Nginx
- Issue: CVE-2026-42533, CVE-2026-60005, and CVE-2026-56434
- Severity: Major for CVE-2026-42533; Medium for CVE-2026-60005 and CVE-2026-56434, per NGINX. NVD and third-party scoring may rate some impacts higher.
- Description: F5/NGINX disclosed vulnerabilities affecting NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source, including a map/regex buffer overflow, memory disclosure in ngx_http_slice_module, and use-after-free in ngx_http_ssi_module. Public reporting and vulnerability database updates continued into the monitoring window.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Nginx, and the NGINX advisory page explicitly names vulnerable NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus version ranges.
- Source: NGINX security advisories: https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html ; F5 notification: https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000161837 ; NVD CVE-2026-60005: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-60005

**Finding 5: Tenable Agent path traversal vulnerability**

- Product: Tenable Nessus / Nessus Agent
- Issue: TNS-2026-18 / CVE-2026-15265
- Severity: Critical, per Tenable
- Description: Tenable disclosed a path traversal issue in Tenable Agent’s plugin directory that could potentially lead to remote code execution. Affected products include Nessus Agent 11.2.0 and Nessus Agent 11.1.3 and earlier.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Tenable Nessus; the affected component is Nessus Agent/Tenable Agent, which is part of Tenable’s Nessus agent deployment stack.
- Source: Tenable advisory TNS-2026-18: https://www.tenable.com/security/tns-2026-18

**Possible matches needing review**

**Microsoft SharePoint Server exploited vulnerabilities**

- Issue: CVE-2026-56164 and related SharePoint KEV activity
- Severity: NVD rates CVE-2026-56164 as Critical; Microsoft CNA scoring lists Medium for the same CVE.
- Why it needs review: NVD describes the affected product as Microsoft Office SharePoint / Microsoft SharePoint Server, and Products.txt includes Microsoft Office but does not explicitly list SharePoint Server. Treat as a possible match only if SharePoint Server is in the environment.
- Source: NVD CVE-2026-56164: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-56164 ; CISA SharePoint alert: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/07/14/cisa-urges-sharepoint-hardening-after-new-exploitations

**Fortinet FortiSandbox KEV update**

- Issue: CVE-2026-39808 and CVE-2026-25089 FortiSandbox OS command injection vulnerabilities
- Severity: Critical for CVE-2026-39808 per Fortinet CNA scoring; CVE-2026-25089 is also listed as Critical by Fortinet.
- Why it needs review: Products.txt lists Fortigate/FortiOS, while the affected product is FortiSandbox / FortiSandbox Cloud / FortiSandbox PaaS, a separate Fortinet product line. Include only if FortiSandbox is actually deployed.
- Source: NVD CVE-2026-39808: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-39808 ; Fortinet FG-IR-26-141: https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt/FG-IR-26-141

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for Chrome, Edge, Zoom, NGINX, and Tenable/Nessus Agent where deployed, with extra urgency for any internet-exposed NGINX services and managed Nessus Agent fleets. SharePoint Server and FortiSandbox should be checked against the environment inventory before treating them as confirmed matches.
